externalMechanicFamily.documentedRules: Each of five reels has a two-coin meter; collecting two coins on a reel makes that reel fully Wild for the next two paid spins, then the meter resets.

historicalStateMathReference.sourceClass: Wizard of Vegas historical mathematical analysis
historicalStateMathReference.modelCaveat: Author explicitly states reel stripping was estimated rather than recovered from the actual game; results are reference-only and cannot set Betfair Spain EV.
historicalStateMathReference.referenceRule: Play when at least two collected coins are present among reels 1-3; reel 5 alone does not drive entry.
historicalStateMathReference.wildReelReference: Already-active Wilds on reels 1-3 were estimated strongly favorable in that model.

None of these facts proves the current Betfair wrapper shares the same provider build, theoretical RTP, reel strips or cross-player state scope.
